headline.text: All three plants ran production through the window with routine machine stops cleared same-shift — no open P1 issues at close.

per_plant_summary.L1: L1 ran all four Sollich lines. Both boilers lost pressure at 21:47 due to a clogged strainer; maintenance cleared it and restored steam by 00:05. S2 had a metal detector belt slip resolved with a CILT by 06:42. S1 cut a belt to prevent loss and resumed. S3 cleared box shortages and completed the order. S4 brought a chiller back online.
per_plant_summary.L2: L2 moulding lines ran filled chocolate bars. ML3 saw doubles three separate times across the shift; each was cleared with jaw cleaning or chain cleaning, longest stop under 15 minutes. An expired barrel pallet remains on hold pending QA decision. FFS finished the 5.1oz order and completed changeover to 3oz.
per_plant_summary.L3: L3 ran molding and truffle. ML4 managed intermittent blooming on shell bars by stationing an EE at demold to remove affected product; no blooming observed by end of shift. ML1 cleared a mold alarm, camera fault, and printer jam. Truffle line cycled through a belt stop and accumulation pause, both resolved same-shift.

notes.text: S1 schedule notes L4 cleaning will complete Monday with 6 hours scheduled; S3 completed order and is set for the long weekend shutdown.
FFS over-produced by 165 cases on the 5.1oz order; 3oz changeover complete and ready for Monday startup.
ML4 shut down at 14:10 for the holiday weekend; Sollich tech began work on the main chiller.

resolved.title: Both boilers lost pressure
resolved.summary: Steam pressure dropped plant-wide at 21:47, slowing caramel cooking on S1 and affecting all lines.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 00:05 — maintenance pulled and cleaned the strainer, boilers returned to pressure (Caleb York).

resolved.title: S3 ran out of corrugated boxes
resolved.summary: Line stopped making finished goods at 03:04; warehouse could not locate boxes, production made WIP to keep line running.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 03:49 — warehouse delivered boxes to the line (Ricardo Tovar).

resolved.title: S2 metal detector belt slipping, timing off
resolved.summary: Belt slip caused metal detection cards to miss the gap during QA check at 05:39.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 06:42 — CILT completed, detector now dumps all three cards (Joseph Scott).

resolved.title: S4 chiller not working
resolved.summary: Chiller failed at 07:09, impacting caramel cooling.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 07:44 — maintenance repaired, chiller now running (S4 Kitchen Tablet).

resolved.title: S1 wrong pouch version staged
resolved.summary: Production was using Item 40674-V2 pouches but spec and BoM call for V1; QA caught during component check at 07:24.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 07:39 — warehouse confirmed V1 pouches in stock and delivered to line (Victor Romero Sr.).

resolved.title: S1 temper climbed during CILT pause
resolved.summary: Line stopped at 06:30 for accumulation and CILT; temper rose to 1.2 during the pause.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 07:22 — operator adjusted mass cooling and water mixing stage down 3 points, temper recovered (S1 Enrober).

resolved.title: ML3 doubles and triples on pack
resolved.summary: Doubles observed at 05:52, line paused for CIL; recurred at 09:28 and 10:08 on separate occasions.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 10:18 — cleaned jaws, increased jaw pressure by half turn, cleaned chain; no more doubles reported (Alex Mendoza).

resolved.title: ML3 film jams
resolved.summary: Line stopped at 09:28 due to film issues.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 09:36 — line running (Molding Line 3 Pack).

resolved.title: ML3 cracked spatula removed from peppermint mixing
resolved.summary: Spatula showed crack at 14:42; QA flagged to prevent foreign material risk.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 15:07 — equipment removed from line and disposed of (Zack Kurtz).

resolved.title: ML3 sensor error stopping pack line
resolved.summary: Sensor fault appeared 5 times on screen at 15:15, line down.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 15:25 — running in under 5 minutes (Molding Line 3 Pack).

resolved.title: ML4 circuit 1 overheated to 107°F
resolved.summary: Refrigerator circuit 1 spiked to 107°F at 15:38 while line was stopped for depositor scraping.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 15:48 — temperature dropped very quickly when put into cooling mode (Shane Olsen).

resolved.title: ML4 bars feeding sideways into wrapper
resolved.summary: Bars going into Theegarten 4 machine sideways at 20:53.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 21:07 — chocolate buildup scraped from infeed, bars tracking correctly (Shane Olsen).

resolved.title: ML4 sticker applicator belt failed
resolved.summary: Sticker machine belt bad, causing issues with caddie stickering; line down at 22:55 and again at 03:37.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 04:00 — running line (ML4 WDS Tablet 1).

resolved.title: Truffle Cavanna 1 exit belt keeps stopping
resolved.summary: Exit belt on Cavanna 1 stopped multiple times starting at 02:09, causing rapid product accumulation.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 02:29 — extended belt running good now (TruffleLine FW).

resolved.title: Truffle line stopped for accumulation
resolved.summary: Line stopped at 04:40 for accumulation and cleaning; 29 bins staged.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 06:07 — depositing restarted, line running (TruffleLine Enrober).

resolved.title: ML4 licking roller 1 not heating
resolved.summary: Licking roller 1 not heating, causing chocolate buildup at 08:28.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 08:28 — plug was disconnected, Nelson Cook reconnected it (Itzel Chavez).

resolved.title: ML1 Cavanna printer code printing cut off
resolved.summary: Line stopped at 11:03 to clean Cavanna printer; code was printing cut off.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 11:10 — printer cleaned, problem solved (Molding Line 1 Flow-Wrap).

resolved.title: ML1 camera fault on vision system
resolved.summary: Camera fault flagged at 13:53, vision system not reading.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 14:02 — camera lens was dirty, cleaned with microfiber cloth (Nathan Ruiz).

resolved.title: Truffle AB1 chocolate pump flow sensor wired wrong
resolved.summary: Chocolate pump kept running when coconut oil pump was down with no flow; flow sensor not changing state.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 13:56 — relay was wired incorrectly, removed relay and set sensor correctly; pump now stops when no flow (Leon Brueger).

resolved.title: ML1 mold alarm
resolved.summary: Mold alarm triggered at 15:19, maintenance notified.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 15:27 — started back up (Imperial).

needs_attention.title: S2 four pallets on hold from metal detector issue
needs_attention.summary: Four pallets placed on hold at 08:10 as a result of the MD belt slip earlier in the shift.
needs_attention.status: On hold as of 08:10; QA flagged product back to last good check for review.

needs_attention.title: S4 caramel too soft, pieces losing shape
needs_attention.summary: Caramel texture too soft at 09:03, causing pieces to lose shape during handling.
needs_attention.status: Operator making temperature adjustments as of 09:03; flow wrap acceptable by 13:22 but no confirmation on texture fix.

needs_attention.title: S1 Yamoto scale setup issues
needs_attention.summary: Vibrating plates not clipped in on MM9 and MM10, funnels not properly fitted into slots at 21:31.
needs_attention.status: Issues identified during startup; no follow-up message indicating correction.

needs_attention.title: S1 rubber fingers starving MM9 and MM10 buckets
needs_attention.summary: Rubber fingers block product from reaching front and back buckets; 5-6 buckets starved, limiting efficiency at 13:35.
needs_attention.status: Design issue impacting throughput; no corrective action posted.

needs_attention.title: ML3 expired chocolate barrels on hold
needs_attention.summary: One barrel of 10228 dark chocolate pulled from warming cabinet at 04:51; pallet discovered to be expired, split into two pallets and placed on hold.
needs_attention.status: On hold as of 04:51 pending Kathleen Gilbert decision on use or discard.

needs_attention.title: ML3 ingredient tank showing buildup along bottom and sides
needs_attention.summary: Warming tank pumping York mass into WDS hopper ran 24 hours straight with no clogging, but buildup observed along bottom and sides at 10:46.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance recommends modifying scraper to reduce buildup; no work order posted.

needs_attention.title: L2 plant area needs clearing

needs_attention.status: Flagged to Alex Mendoza and Jeffrey Barney to coach team on cleanup; no completion confirmation.

needs_attention.summary: Temper unit not keeping in line with settings since yesterday; fluctuating throughout the shift at 23:14.
needs_attention.status: Still seeing issues as of 23:14; Chad Stone asked for Marcos (L1) to troubleshoot at 05:20, no follow-up posted.

needs_attention.summary: Sensor B120 not functioning at 06:45, maintenance called.
